general.description: Manage the local memory storage location and review the embedding model the memory stack depends on.

reranker_enabled.description: Add an optional reranker stage after retrieval fusion so top candidates can be re-evaluated before final ranking.

l1.label: L1 event memory

l4.label: L4 skill memory

workbench.queueBody: This lighter rail helps you choose which runtime thread deserves attention before diving into the full workbench.

events.subtitle: Inspect the long-term event stream and query it with explicit filters.
events.focusHeadline: Read the density of memory intake by source and content
events.focusBody: This layer behaves like a retained draft of experience. Narrow by source first, then move into the event contents.

knowledge.subtitle: Inspect the knowledge graph, ToM assertions, and lab controls with entity-aware filtering.
knowledge.searchPlaceholder: Filter knowledge memory by entity, relation, or assertion
knowledge.focusBody: The knowledge page should feel like a slow-growing garden. Start with entity type, then move deeper into relations, assertions, and snapshots.
knowledge.entitySummaryBody: Use the active entity types to sense what kind of knowledge is surfacing before reading the full structure.
knowledge.structureBody: Frequent predicates and identity-link counts offer a quick read on the shape of the graph.
knowledge.identitySummary: {{count}} identity links in the current filtered view

reflection.subtitle: Inspect generated reflections and summaries with type-aware filtering.
reflection.searchPlaceholder: Filter reflection memory by summary content or category
reflection.focusHeadline: See how memory is being gently reorganized
reflection.focusBody: This layer is no longer raw record. It is the language that remains after time and summarization start to shape the memory.
reflection.cadenceBody: Check which summary types are active first, then move into the written reflections with that rhythm in mind.
reflection.topicsBody: This keeps the repeated themes visible so you can feel the direction of the reflection layer at a glance.
reflection.insightBody: Task reviews, state shifts, and trend changes should be readable as different lanes instead of one flat stream.
reflection.noTopics: No explicit topics surfaced in the current summaries

skills.subtitle: Inspect procedural skills and breaker state with skill-level filtering.
skills.searchPlaceholder: Filter tool and skill memory by name or category
skills.focusHeadline: See which abilities feel stable and which still need care
skills.focusBody: The skills page works best when success rate, breaker state, and category are read together as one evolving capability profile.
skills.categoryBody: Start with the most active categories, then move into specific capabilities when you know where the concentration is.
skills.attentionBody: This area highlights stable capability and any state that may still need a closer look.

help.layerId: Unique identifier for this layer, e.g. crack, revealed. Represents the depth stage of persona unlock.
help.unlockCondition: When all conditions are met simultaneously, this layer activates and its overrides are injected into the prompt.
help.trustLevelGte: Trust ranges from 0 to 1, starting at 0.5. Each successful interaction adds +0.02, failure subtracts −0.01.
help.interactionCountGte: Total chat turns between the user and AI. Each turn (user message + AI reply) counts as 1.
help.milestoneRequired: Milestones are detected by the AI during conversation. Enter a key defined in milestone_conditions of the persona config.
help.personaOverride: Overrides the character's traits (e.g. tone, empathy) when unlocked. Keys are free-form and rendered as 'Attribute: value' in the prompt.
help.behaviorHints: Specific actions the character will take when this layer is unlocked. One per line, describing concrete behaviors at this depth.

actions.viewLayersConfirm: Deep persona layers contain hidden character settings and progressive unlock mechanics. Viewing them may spoil the discovery experience. Are you sure?
